subject: Add extractForwardedDate helper + tests
description: Create supabase/functions/_shared/forwardedEmailDate.ts with a TZ-safe extractForwardedDate(body) that parses the forwarded-header Date:/Sent: line (month-name + ISO forms) into YYYY-MM-DD, and a co-located vitest .test.ts covering Gmail/Apple/Outlook/RFC formats, forward-of-forward, ambiguous-numeric rejection, and null tail.
